title.zh: FCA Guidance Lands Two Weeks Before UK Crypto Authorization Window Opens
title.en: FCA Guidance Lands Two Weeks Before UK Crypto Authorization Window Opens

current_state.zh: 英国 FCA 已发布加密授权最终指南；申请窗口于 9 月 30 日开放，现有注册不会自动转换，寻求过渡安排的公司需在 2027 年 2 月 28 日前申请，新制度将于 2027 年 10 月 25 日生效。
current_state.en: The UK FCA has published final crypto authorization guidance; the application window opens Sept. 30, existing registrations do not automatically convert, firms seeking transitional arrangements face a Feb. 28, 2027 deadline, and the new regime takes effect Oct. 25, 2027.

updates.title_zh: UK FCA sets crypto authorization guidance ahead of September application window
updates.title_en: UK FCA sets crypto authorization guidance ahead of September application window
updates.what_changed_zh: FCA 最新指引确认为最终指南，明确需要授权的加密活动类别，并说明现有注册/许可不会自动转换；同时给出过渡申请截止日为 2027 年 2 月 28 日。
updates.what_changed_en: The FCA guidance is now described as final, specifies covered crypto activities, states that existing registrations/permissions will not automatically convert, and adds a Feb. 28, 2027 transitional application deadline.
updates.current_state_zh: 英国 FCA 已发布加密授权最终指南；申请窗口于 9 月 30 日开放，现有注册不会自动转换，寻求过渡安排的公司需在 2027 年 2 月 28 日前申请，新制度将于 2027 年 10 月 25 日生效。
updates.current_state_en: The UK FCA has published final crypto authorization guidance; the application window opens Sept. 30, existing registrations do not automatically convert, firms seeking transitional arrangements face a Feb. 28, 2027 deadline, and the new regime takes effect Oct. 25, 2027.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The UK FCA published final guidance clarifying which crypto activities require authorization under its incoming regime, ahead of the September application window, with existing registrations not automatically converting.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The UK FCA published final guidance clarifying which crypto activities require authorization under its incoming regime, ahead of the September application window, with existing registrations not automatically converting.
updates.background_zh: 英国正在建立一套专门的监管制度，依据《金融服务与市场法》（FSMA）将加密资产纳入FCA的监管范围，而不再仅让公司停留在现有的反洗钱注册框架之下。英国议会已于2月批准相关授权立法，FCA在6月敲定了一揽子规则与指引，并计划在2027年前分阶段过渡。“合格稳定币”指的是试图通过锚定法定货币（如英镑或美元）来维持价值的加密资产。此外，英国上议院以194票对138票通过了一项对《金融服务与市场法》法案的修正案，要求财政部在该法案生效后12个月内制定一项涵盖加密资产、稳定币、代币化证券和数字金融基础设施的数字资产战略。
updates.background_en: The UK is building a dedicated regulatory regime that brings cryptoassets into the FCA's remit under the Financial Services and Markets Act (FSMA), rather than leaving firms under the existing anti-money-laundering registration framework. Parliament approved the enabling regulations in February and the FCA finalized a package of rules and guidance in June, with a phased transition planned through 2027. "Qualifying stablecoins" refers to cryptoassets that seek to maintain their value by reference to a fiat currency, such as sterling or the US dollar. Separately, the House of Lords voted 194–138 to amend the Financial Services and Markets Bill to require the Treasury to produce a digital asset strategy within 12 months of the bill becoming law.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该指引将影响所有涉及英国零售业务的交易场所和服务提供商的市场结构——包括交易平台、交易商、托管方和质押服务安排方——因为获得授权成为继续进入英国市场的前提，而缺乏海外主体豁免使得非英国公司也被纳入监管范围。合规成本与牌照风险是主要的传导渠道，并会对英镑计价稳定币的发行以及FCA另行审查的代币化资产产品产生连带影响。
updates.market_impact_en: The guidance affects market structure for any venue or service provider with UK retail exposure — trading platforms, dealers, custodians and staking arrangers — since authorization becomes a precondition for continued market access, and the absence of an overseas persons exclusion pulls non-UK firms into scope. Compliance cost and licensing risk are the main transmission channels, with knock-on implications for GBP-denominated stablecoin issuance and for tokenized asset products the FCA is reviewing separately.
